intro: Uzbekistan is a presidential republic in which the president holds most power.

chapters.title: How it works
text: President Shavkat Mirziyoyev has led since 2016. A 2023 referendum extended presidential terms to seven years. Parliament has two chambers.

chapters.title: Reforms
text: Since 2016 the government has ended forced labour in the cotton harvest and made travel and business easier, though political freedoms remain limited.
